verdict_vs_market.quote: This is a good, market-competitive Google L6 offer, but it is not compelling enough to accept without negotiating.

equity_grounding.quote: Recent U.S. data puts the reported L6 90th percentile around $671K, though that dataset mixes new offers and existing employees and may include refresh stacking.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: Recent compensation data puts Bay Area Google L6 PM median compensation at roughly $551K, while broader U.S. data shows a $514K median and approximately $671K at the 90th percentile.

caveat_tenure_offering_company.quote: though that dataset mixes new offers and existing employees and may include refresh stacking.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Do not value unspecified refresh grants as part of the offer.

level_claim.quote: You are already at the same level at Meta.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: If Google barely moves, stay at Meta unless the role itself is substantially better.

rsu_annualized.quote: At $1.08M over four years, the grant has an annualized value of $270K.

forfeiture_as_loss.quote: You are forfeiting meaningful near-term equity.
